[P1] 童读·中华经典神话故事
仙女造桥
李永风/改编 树树虎/绘
中国人口出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P2] 中华经典神话故事绘本
仙女造桥
李永凤/改编 树树虎/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P3] 农历七月十五，中元节。
“两位妹妹，这是你俩第一次去人间承受香火供奉，该注意的，都记住了吗？”天庭九霄宫中，上元仙女拉着中元仙女和下元仙女叮嘱道。
“放心吧，姐姐。”
“我们一定完成任务。”

[P4] 南天门前，两位仙女
准备下凡。
“中元姐姐，咱们去哪个地方呢？”下元仙女问。

“二郎神对我说过，他曾挑了两座山放在渤海，形成了两座海岛，因为山的形状特别像笔架，所以人间的老百姓叫它们大小笔架山。我们就去那里吧。”中元仙女想了想，对妹妹说道。

[P5] “好。五彩祥云速来！”下元仙
子话音刚落，就飘来一朵五彩祥云，
载着两位仙女飞下天界。

她们飞到渤海上空，降低云头，只见大小笔架山
山清水秀，树木茂盛，海浪拍岸，微风吹拂，海天一色，
真是美极了。

[P6] 陆地和海岛之间有许多大大小小的礁石，几只小船正小心躲避着，奋力回航。
看到这些，中元仙女心想：此处海面并不宽，如果有座大桥连接海岛和陆地，那人们岂不是方便多了？
“景色这么美，我们下去逛逛吧。”下元仙女开心地建议道。
姐妹俩悄悄降落，正好看到一只船靠岸了。

[P7] 一位老奶奶提着装满香烛贡品的篮子，牵着一个五六岁的小男孩走下船来。
“奶奶，这里真美啊，我想每天都来玩！”小男孩一边兴奋地说，一边四处望。
“我们是来岛上道观供奉神仙的，烧完香就得赶紧回去了。可不能贪玩到天黑，天黑之后……”
奶奶说着，拉紧了小男孩的手。
“我知道，天黑了，那条吃人的大黑龙就出来了！”
小男孩听话地加快了脚步。

[P8] “你看那道观，香火多么旺盛！百姓对我们这么好，我们也为他们做点儿事吧。我看，不如造两座桥，方便他们来来往往。”中元仙女提议道。
下元仙女拍手叫好。
姐妹俩约定：天一黑就去造桥，中元仙女去大笔架山，下元仙女去小笔架山，然后在天亮之前造好两座桥。

[P9] 夜幕降临。
“移山填海！”中元仙女驾着五彩祥云，升到大笔架山的上空，开始施展法术。
远处缓缓飘来一座小山，停在大笔架山与陆地之间的海面上。
中元仙女准备再次施展法术，将小山变成一座桥。

[P10] 突然，“哗啦”一声，海面上腾空跃出一个黑影，像巨大的鞭子一样向小山抽去。
“轰——”小山轰然倒塌。

[P11] 中元仙女定睛一看，这个黑影正是小男孩说的大黑龙！
眼看大桥即将造成，却被作恶多端的黑龙给破坏了，中元仙女非常生气，立刻从衣袖中抽出拂尘，准备与大黑龙战斗。
“姐姐，我来助你！”下元仙女听到这边的动静，匆匆赶来。

[P12] “哈哈，凭你们两个小女娃，就想打败我？真是太可笑了！”大黑龙得意地大笑着，龙身飞腾，龙鳞闪烁，大嘴一吸一张，一股凶猛的海水向两位仙女喷涌而去。
中元仙女飞身闪开，用拂尘施展法术，想把大黑龙捆绑起来。下元仙女却躲闪不及，瞬间被海水包围了。

[P13] 看到妹妹陷入险境，中元仙女着急万分，赶紧上前营救。
这时，天空突然被一片巨大的黑影笼罩了。紧接着，金光闪耀，原来是金翅大鹏前来相助。
听到大鹏鸟的啸声，大黑龙颤抖了一下，赶紧停止喷吐海水，扭头就跑，但已经来不及了，大鹏鸟伸出铁一般的巨爪，一下子抠进龙身，紧紧抓起大黑龙冲天而起，很快就不见了踪影。

[P14] 经过一番战斗，两位仙女有点儿疲惫，但她们打起精神继续造桥，飞到空中重新施法。
月亮温柔地照着大地，仙女们的汗珠滴滴闪亮，像一颗颗珍珠落入大海。
海中渐渐出现了两座仙桥，分别成为联通大小笔架山和陆地之间的连接通道。

[P15] 两位仙女擦了擦汗，看着两座仙桥满意地笑了，这下人们的通行就方便多了。她们驾起祥云，回天庭去了。
第二天早上，小男孩又来到海边，隔着大海遥望着笔架山，他想去那儿玩。

[P16] 过了很久，海水开始落潮了。
“咦，这是怎么回事啊？”小男孩惊奇地发现：就像有只无形的大手，在慢慢把海水往两边推，推啊推，推啊推，居然推出来两座桥，直通大笔架山和小笔架山！

[P17] “有大桥喽！有大桥喽！”小男孩飞奔回家，
告诉乡亲们这一好消息。
乡亲们惊喜万分，都赶了过来，看一看，走
一走，踩一踩……
得到大人的允许后，小男孩欢快地和小伙伴
们在仙桥上奔跑起来，向大笔架山冲去！
过了些天，人们又发现了两座大桥的规律：
落潮时，随着海水慢慢退去，桥慢慢出现，变宽
变长，连接上陆地与大小笔架山；涨潮时，随着海水
从两边涌来，桥又慢慢变窄，直到被海水完全覆盖。
“这真是两座仙桥啊！”人们赞叹道。

[P1] Children's Reading · Classic Chinese Mythological Stories
Fairy Building a Bridge
Adapted by Li Yongfeng, Illustrated by Shushu Hu
China Population Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P2] Chinese Classic Mythology Picture Book
Fairy Building a Bridge
Adapted by Li Yongfeng, Illustrated by Shushu Hu
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P3] The 15th day of the seventh lunar month, the Zhongyuan Festival.
"Two younger sisters, this is your first time going to the mortal world to receive incense offerings. Have you remembered everything you should pay attention to?" In the Nine Heavens Palace of Heaven, the Upper Yuan Fairy pulled the Middle Yuan Fairy and the Lower Yuan Fairy, reminding them.
"Don't worry, sister."
"We will definitely complete our mission."

[P4] Before the Southern Heavenly Gate, two fairies
prepare to descend to the mortal world.
"Sister Zhongyuan, where should we go?" asked the fairy Xiaoyuan.

"Erlang Shen told me that he once carried two mountains to the Bohai Sea, forming two islands. Because the mountains resemble a writing brush stand, the people of the mortal world call them Da and Xiao Bijia Mountains. Let's go there," said the fairy Zhongyuan after thinking, speaking to her younger sister.

[P5] "Good. Rainbow cloud, come quickly!" As the Lower Yuan Fairy's words fell, a rainbow cloud drifted by, carrying the two fairies down to the mortal world.

They flew over the Bohai Sea, lowered their cloud, and saw the Big and Small BiJia Mountains—clear waters, lush trees, waves crashing against the shore, gentle breezes blowing, sky and sea blending into one color—truly beautiful!

[P6] Between the mainland and the islands, there are many large and small rocks, and several small boats are carefully avoiding them, struggling to return.
Seeing this, the Middle Yuan Fairy thought: If there were a big bridge connecting the island and the mainland, wouldn't it be much more convenient for people?
"The scenery is so beautiful, let's go down and take a look," the Lower Yuan Fairy suggested happily.
The two sisters quietly descended, just in time to see a boat docking.

[P7] An old grandmother, carrying a basket full of incense and offerings, led a little boy of five or six years old off the boat.
"Grandma, this place is so beautiful! I want to come here every day to play!" the boy said excitedly, looking around.
"We're here to offer incense to the gods at the temple on the island. We must hurry back after we finish. Don't stay and play until it gets dark. After dark..."
The grandmother said this, pulling the boy's hand tighter.
"I know, when it gets dark, the big black dragon that eats people will come out!"
The boy obediently quickened his pace.

[P8] "Look at that temple, how prosperous the incense is! The people are so kind to us, let's do something for them. I think we should build two bridges to make it easier for them to come and go," suggested the Middle Yuan Fairy.
The Lower Yuan Fairy clapped her hands in approval.
The sisters agreed: as soon as it gets dark, they would build the bridges—the Middle Yuan Fairy to Big Bi Jia Mountain, the Lower Yuan Fairy to Small Bi Jia Mountain—and finish both bridges before dawn.

[P9] Night fell.
"Move mountains and fill the sea!" The Zhongyuan Fairy rode on a colorful cloud, ascending above the Big BiJia Mountain to begin her magic.
A small mountain slowly floated from afar, stopping on the sea between the Big BiJia Mountain and the mainland.
The Zhongyuan Fairy prepared to use her magic again, to turn the small mountain into a bridge.

[P10] Suddenly, with a 'splash,' a dark shadow leapt from the sea surface, whipping toward the small hill like a giant lash.
'Boom——' the small hill collapsed with a thunderous crash.

[P11] The Zhongyuan Fairy looked closely and realized this dark shadow was indeed the big black dragon the little boy had mentioned!
Seeing the bridge about to be completed, it was destroyed by the wicked black dragon. The Zhongyuan Fairy became very angry and immediately pulled out her whisk from her sleeve, preparing to fight the black dragon.
"Sister, I'm here to help you!" The Xiayuan Fairy, hearing the commotion, hurried over.

[P12] "Haha, with just the two of you little girls, do you think you can defeat me? How ridiculous!" The big black dragon laughed triumphantly, his body soaring, scales gleaming, his huge mouth opening and closing, spraying a fierce surge of seawater toward the two fairies.
Zhongyuan Fairy dodged swiftly, wielding her whisk to cast a spell, trying to bind the black dragon. But Xiaoyuan Fairy failed to dodge in time and was instantly surrounded by seawater.

[P13] Seeing her sister in danger, the middle Yuan fairy was extremely anxious and rushed forward to rescue her.
At this moment, the sky was suddenly covered by a huge dark shadow. Then, golden light flashed — it was the golden-winged great Peng bird coming to help.
Hearing the Peng bird's roar, the big black dragon trembled, quickly stopped spitting seawater, turned around to flee, but it was too late. The Peng bird extended its iron-like giant claws, plunged them into the dragon's body, firmly grabbed the black dragon, and soared into the sky — soon disappearing from sight.

[P14] After a fierce battle, the two fairies felt a bit tired, but they rallied their spirits and continued building the bridge, flying into the sky to cast their spells again.
The moon gently illuminated the earth, and the fairies' sweat droplets sparkled brightly, like pearls falling into the sea.
Gradually, two fairy bridges appeared in the sea, becoming the connecting passages between the Big and Small BiJia Mountains and the mainland.

[P15] The two fairies wiped their sweat, looked at the two fairy bridges, and smiled with satisfaction. Now people's travel would be much easier. They mounted their auspicious clouds and returned to the heavenly palace.

The next morning, the little boy came to the seaside again, gazing across the sea at the Brush Mountain, wishing to go and play there.

[P16] After a long time, the seawater began to recede.
"Huh, what's going on?" the boy wondered, amazed to discover: it was as if an invisible giant hand was slowly pushing the seawater aside, pushing and pushing, pushing and pushing, until two bridges emerged, connecting the Big Brush Mountain and the Small Brush Mountain!

[P17] "There's a big bridge! There's a big bridge!" The little boy ran home excitedly, 
telling the villagers the good news.
The villagers were thrilled and rushed over to see, walk, 
and step on it...
With the adults' permission, the little boy happily ran with his friends 
on the fairy bridge, rushing toward the Big Pen-Bracket Mountain!
After a few days, people discovered the pattern of the two great bridges: 
During low tide, as the seawater slowly receded, the bridge gradually appeared, widened, 
and lengthened, connecting the land with the Big and Small Pen-Bracket Mountains; during high tide, as seawater surged in from both sides, the bridge gradually narrowed until completely covered by water.
"These are truly two fairy bridges!" the people exclaimed with admiration.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《仙女造桥》的封面，展示了两位仙女在山水间飞舞的插画，上方有书名、作者和出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《仙女造桥》的封面，展示了两位仙女在山水间飞舞的插画，上方有书名、作者和出版社信息。
[P3] 本页描绘了农历七月十五中元节，上元仙女在天庭九霄宫中叮嘱中元仙女和下元仙女，她们将首次前往人间接受香火供奉，并承诺会完成任务。
[P4] 南天门前，两位仙女准备下凡，下元仙女询问去处，中元仙女提议前往渤海的大小笔架山。
[P5] 下元仙女召唤五彩祥云，载着两位仙女飞下天界，她们抵达渤海上空，俯瞰大小笔架山，赞叹其山清水秀、景色优美。
[P6] 两位仙女俯瞰渤海上大小笔架山，看到海面礁石密布，船只艰难航行，中元仙女心生建桥之念，下元仙女提议下凡游览，她们降落时恰见一船靠岸。
[P7] 一位老奶奶带着小男孩从船上下来，准备去岛上道观供奉神仙。小男孩对美景充满向往，但奶奶提醒他天黑后会有吃人的大黑龙，于是他听话地加快脚步。
[P8] 中元仙女提议为百姓建造两座桥以方便往来，下元仙女赞同，姐妹俩约定天黑后分别前往大小笔架山，在天亮前完成造桥任务。
[P9] 夜幕降临，中元仙女驾着五彩祥云飞至大笔架山上空，施展法术，将一座小山移至海面，准备将其变为桥梁。
[P10] 夜幕下，一条黑龙从海中腾空跃出，用巨尾抽击中元仙女移至海面的小山，导致小山轰然倒塌。
[P11] 中元仙女发现破坏桥梁的黑龙，愤怒地准备战斗，下元仙女闻声赶来相助。
[P12] 大黑龙嘲笑两位仙女并喷出海水攻击，中元仙女用拂尘法术闪避并试图捆绑黑龙，下元仙女则被海水包围。
[P13] 中元仙女正欲营救妹妹，金翅大鹏突然现身，用巨爪抓住大黑龙并将其带离，化解了危机。
[P14] 两位仙女在与黑龙战斗后稍作休整，重新施法造桥，最终在海中建起两座连接大小笔架山与陆地的仙桥。
[P15] 两位仙女完成造桥后驾云返回天庭，而小男孩第二天清晨再次来到海边，遥望笔架山，心生向往。
[P16] 小男孩在海边发现海水退潮后，两座桥奇迹般地出现在海面上，直通大小笔架山。
[P17] 小男孩发现海中出现大桥后，兴奋地跑回家告知乡亲，大家纷纷前来观看并体验。随后人们发现桥梁随潮汐变化而显现或隐没的规律，赞叹其为仙桥。
[P18] 画面中三位仙女身着彩衣，立于云雾缭绕的水边，衣带飘舞，背景有荷叶点缀，整体呈现仙气飘渺的意境。
